states.name: Idle
states.meaning: No request submitted; query or page is awaiting explicit action.
states.presentation: Give labels and task guidance; no invented results or default 100%.
states.recovery: Edit controls or submit after validation.
states.accessibility: Leave focus at current control; status may be silent until an action.

states.name: Loading
states.presentation: Retain safe draft; label progress; skeleton is not data; no old results presented as current.
states.recovery: Cancel locally or wait; ignore response after cancellation, query replacement or session change.
states.accessibility: Announce short loading status once; preserve focus and avoid repeated live announcements.

states.name: Ready
states.meaning: Authorized operation completed with usable data under current rights/snapshot.
states.presentation: Render only DTO fields the caller may see; display coverage/source/method where applicable.
states.recovery: Inspect, edit, compare or explicitly submit another action.
states.accessibility: Announce completion/count summary without moving focus; route navigation focuses main heading.

states.name: Valid Empty
states.meaning: Authorized successful completed operation returned a valid empty set.
states.presentation: Explain no matching records and active filters; valid empty is not unknown notes, missing capability or a closed-domain emptiness claim.
states.recovery: Clear or narrow filters, or add own first record through authorized flow.
states.accessibility: Announce no results, retain search focus, offer labeled recovery button.

states.name: Partial / Incomplete
states.meaning: Authorized subset is usable but coverage, layering, completeness or search completion is limited.
states.presentation: Show known facts and explicit gaps; do not imply absent notes, full search or measured intensity.
states.recovery: Inspect allowed metadata; change query/filters or await separately approved review.
states.accessibility: Associate each gap label with its section; announce concise partial-result summary.

states.name: Unknown
states.meaning: Authorized field or condition has no reliable known value.
states.presentation: Use Unknown/not recorded; general notes remain All Listed Notes; unknown price and no valid score are never zero.
states.recovery: Inspect permitted provenance or record optional own data explicitly.
states.accessibility: Expose text alternatives; do not encode uncertainty through color alone.

states.name: Unavailable
states.meaning: Operation, method, domain, rights-safe value or media cannot be supplied.
states.presentation: Show generic unavailable; give dependency reason only if independently authorized; real matching remains blocked without synthetic fallback.
states.recovery: Offer permitted factual view or another supported task; no unsafe auto retry.
states.accessibility: Label disabled controls and explain why without private existence leakage.

states.name: Unauthorized
states.meaning: Session/scope/object/field authorization does not permit operation.
states.presentation: Use the same safe presentation for denied and nonexistent private objects; no protected count, hold, source or asset detail.
states.recovery: Authenticate if appropriate or return to permitted navigation; retry reauthorizes from start.
states.accessibility: Generic accessible message and permitted recovery; no hidden DOM/private announcement details.

states.name: Conflicted / Held
states.meaning: Known authorized review object has a conflict or hold preventing a particular use.
states.presentation: Show safe blocked capability generally; disclose hold/conflict reason only to a user allowed to know object and review evidence.
states.recovery: Use factual permitted fields or submit authorized review proposal; never release hold through a display action.
states.accessibility: Text label with authorized reason; offer review link only when role and object permission permit.

states.name: Expired / Revoked
states.meaning: Session, membership, snapshot or rights are no longer current.
states.presentation: For unknown/unauthorized objects use generic denial; only previously known and still authorized context may show safe expiry detail. Stop display/delivery of protected stale content.
states.recovery: Reauthenticate or restart with new authorization/snapshot; no silent replay or stale membership reuse.
states.accessibility: Announce safe session/content change once; focus recovery heading when current context is removed.

states.name: Timeout
states.meaning: Operation exceeded budget or completion cannot be established.
states.presentation: State incomplete search/action status; do not claim valid empty, completed mutation or exhaustive ranking.
states.recovery: Narrow query; explicit safe retry. For uncertain writes re-read authorized state/idempotency outcome before replay.
states.accessibility: Announce timeout; preserve safe inputs and focus recovery summary when user action is needed.

states.name: Validation Error
states.meaning: Explicit input contract rejects unknown, malformed, contradictory, unbounded or stale-version data.
states.presentation: Show field-specific actionable errors without raw request payloads, SQL, stack traces or private existence.
states.recovery: Correct inputs, refresh stale version, or cancel; no hidden coercion/default permission.
states.accessibility: Focus linked error summary on failed submit; mark/describe invalid fields and retain safe user input.

states.name: Offline
states.meaning: Network/service connectivity is unavailable; browser connectivity hint alone does not prove server state.
states.presentation: Show unavailable private operation, never cached protected result as current; no persistent private offline data or queued writes.
states.recovery: Reconnect then explicitly retry with fresh session/rights; static shell may remain only if separately safe.
states.accessibility: Announce connectivity once; keep retry keyboard accessible; do not trap focus or claim a write succeeded.
